engine: Springs section ENTRY wipe — a panel enters as a hard VERTICAL seam wiping L->R and parking at the column split (50%), while the outgoing full-bleed image crop-zooms to recompose into the shrinking column. Harvested from D_springs SEAM-02 (f014->f017).

measured_teardown.move: a colour panel is revealed by a clip-path inset growing from the LEFT — inset(0 100% 0 0) -> inset(0 (100-park)% 0 0) — so a crisp vertical seam sweeps L->R and STOPS at the column split (~50%). Simultaneously the outgoing image (shrinking right half) crop-zooms (scale up + transform-origin shift) to stay composed. Scroll-scrubbed, reversible.
measured_teardown.role: the section ENTRY that hands off into the coupled-split / dual-slicer (Springs Building -> Open-doors).

park.what: where the seam stops = the column split.

zoom.what: outgoing image crop-zoom (scale 1 -> 1+zoom) as its column narrows.

manageLenis.what: create+drive a Lenis (false if the page owns one).

entry: VerticalCurtainWipe.init(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, render, refresh, destroy }. Markup: .vcw-stage > .vcw-out(img, the crop-zooming media) + .vcw-panel(the entering panel, clip-revealed L->R to park%).
law: Lenis -> gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger.update; lagSmoothing(0); render(prog) PURE; pin/scrub; clip-path + transform only; GPU layers; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the scrubbed surface; NO WebGL; reduced-motion/<=820px -> static (panel at park, image composed). ONE scroll owner per page.
gate_mode: normal/curtain (the panel covers the image L->R; both solid; no blank). PASS = 0 blank, fps>=50.
proven: lab: OUR render full-bleed, a green panel wiping in to the 50% split (heading inside), the render crop-zooming in the right half. Clip inset(0 100% 0 0) at top -> inset(0 72%) mid -> inset(0 50%) parked at end; img scale 1 -> 1.067 -> 1.12. Gate (curtain) PASS: 0 blank, 0 seam, 59.9fps, jank 1/687.
